name: Rightmove API
tagline: UK property portal partner APIs for listings, branches, and property data.
description: Rightmove is the UK's largest property portal. It offers partner-facing APIs (including property data export and branch/listing integrations) for approved estate agents, developers, and data partners rather than open self-serve public access. Access, endpoints, and commercial terms are typically arranged through Rightmove partnerships; public marketing pages do not document a fully open developer API.

auth.details: Partner/commercial access only; not self-serve. Exact auth mechanism (API key, certificates, or other) is provided under partner agreement and is not fully documented on public pages.

example.response_snippet: Partner-only API; public sample responses not available on marketing pages.

use_cases: export UK property listing data as a Rightmove partner
sync estate agent branch details with Rightmove
ingest Rightmove property feed for internal CRM or analytics
integrate agent property stock with Rightmove portal listings
